acquisition_method.evidence: The Q Exactive was operated in data-dependent mode with survey scans acquired at a resolution of 75,000 at m/z 200 (transient time 256 ms).

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Cysteines were alkylated (2.5 μl of 100 mM iodoacetamide in 50 mM AMBIC) at RT for 30 min in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Cysteines were alkylated (2.5 μl of 100 mM iodoacetamide in 50 mM AMBIC) at RT for 30 min in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin (2 μg Sequencing Grade Modified Trypsin (Promega) dissolved in 50 mM AMBIC) was added to the beads and the samples were placed on a shaker and digested overnight at 37 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: Up to 10 of the most abundant isotope patterns with charge +2 or higher from the survey scan were selected with an isolation window of 3.0 m/z and fragmented by higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) with normalized collision energies of 25.

enrichment_method.evidence: NeutrAvidin agarose resin (Thermo Scientific) was washed with 0.2% SDS in PBS (3 × ).

fragmentation_method.evidence: Up to 10 of the most abundant isotope patterns with charge +2 or higher from the survey scan were selected with an isolation window of 3.0 m/z and fragmented by higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) with normalized collision energies of 25.

instrument.evidence: Easy nLC-1000 was coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer via an easy-spray source (all Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: Easy nLC-1000 was coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer via an easy-spray source (all Thermo Fisher Scientific).

labeling.evidence: For quantitative proteomics (spike-in SILAC and SILAC), R10K8 and R0K0 Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium (DMEM) media were purchased from Dundee Cell Products.
LFQ experiments in MaxQuant were performed using the built-in LFQ algorithm enabling the ‘match between runs’ option (time window 2 min), and were processed with Perseus version 1.3.0.4.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Easy nLC-1000 was coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer via an easy-spray source (all Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ptm.evidence: Cysteine carbamidomethylation was used as a fixed modification and methionine oxidation as a variable modification.

reduction_concentration.evidence: For a 50 μl bed of beads, samples were reduced (2.5 μl of 100 mM DTT in 50 mM AMBIC) at 60 °C for 30 min and allowed to cool to RT.
